annotations.text: Negative x₁ pushed the output below 0.
The error grew as the prediction moved away from 1.

beats.say: When x₁ changed from 1 to -1, the prediction moved from 0.420 to -0.268. The loss increased from 0.168 to 0.804 because the output moved farther from the target 1.
The important change is the sign flip: the output went from positive to negative. This example shows the network is sensitive to the sign of x₁.

After: total mass 2900 kg, acceleration -4.84 m/s²

object.content: Crash: 4.99 s, altitude 0 m, velocity -36.07 m/s
